notes.title: Spanish (European) translation released
notes.content:
🎉 We're thrilled to announce that FixFox is now available in Spanish (European), all thanks to our amazing community volunteers! 🎉

To enjoy FixFox in your preferred language, simply restart Steam to get the latest update, then head to Settings to change the language. Happy exploring!

A huge shoutout and round of applause to these incredible translators for their hard work and dedication. 🌟👏

[b]Spanish (European):[/b]
- Poorscoot
- Zam
- Francisco Burgos

Translations to other languages are in the works, including Turkish, German, French, Slovak, Polish, Portuguese-Brazil, Russian, Persian, Spanish (Latam), and Finnish. If you want to join the effort, please visit [url=https://bit.ly/FixFoxDiscord]FixFox Discord[/url].

tags.feature: 🎉 We're thrilled to announce that FixFox is now available in Spanish (European), all thanks to our amazing community volunteers! 🎉

notes.title: Czech localization and physical edition
notes.content:
FixFox now supports the [b]Czech language[/b]!

With Czech being my mother tongue, I'm happy for it to be the first localization that FixFox has received.
Restart Steam to update the game, go to Settings and change Language.
Huge thanks goes to [url=https://www.xzone.cz/]Xzone[/url] for sponsoring the translation!

We're also releasing a limited [b]FixFox Xzone edition[/b]!

If you're living in Czechia, grab it here:
[h3][url=https://www.xzone.cz/fixfox-pc]www.xzone.cz/fixfox-pc[/url][/h3]

It includes:
[list]
[*] artbook showcasing behind-the-scenes materials
[*] sheet of pirate stickers
[*] four postcards
[*] digital soundtrack
[*] FixFox Steam key
[/list]

notes.title: Savefile Saviour
notes.content:
[b]TLDR:[/b] If your save files seemed to disappear, this update fixes the issue. Your savefiles are safe!

[b]Detailed explanation:[/b]
Your savefiles are supposed to be stored here:
Users\<USER>\AppData\LocalLow\Rendlike\FixFox\<STEAMUSERID>
The Summer Update build was, however, looking for files here:
Users\<USER>\AppData\LocalLow\Rendlike\FixFox\Vix

The current update:
- fixes the issue, looking into the correct folder. You should see your save files again.
- if you've just started playing the game, the game looks into [b]Vix[/b] directory and copies the files into the correct directory

Make sure to restart Steam after the update.

If you encounter any more issues, please contact me at [b]fixfoxgame@gmail.com[/b].

Sorry for your inconvenience!

tags.bug: - fixes the issue, looking into the correct folder. You should see your save files again.
- if you've just started playing the game, the game looks into [b]Vix[/b] directory and copies the files into the correct directory
